TITLE: City and living | Eindhoven

City and living
Where to start if you have questions or complaints?
Waste and recycling
Information on the collection of household waste at houses (apartment buildings excluded).
Afval
Waste recycling point
Contact details and opening hours. Information about waste for recycling, and the regulations on disposing of your bulky refuse, asbestos, textiles and green waste.
Milieustraat
Sewerage charge
You must a sewerage levy if your home or business premises are connected directly or indirectly to the municipal sewer system.
Rioolheffing
If anything goes wrong
Complaints
Naturally, we want our residents to be able to live happily in our municipality. We therefore give you the opportunity of reporting any complaints if anything goes wrong.
Klachten
Reporting a blocked sewer
Is your sewer blocked? Engage the services of a specialist company to unblock it.
Verstopt riool melden
Public space report
You can report a public space issue by phone on 14 040, by way of the BuitenBeter app, or on our website.
Melding openbare ruimte
Lost and found
Have you lost something in Eindhoven? Or you'd like to know if your lost item has been found?
Verloren of gevonden voorwerpen
